name: nscale
description: Serverless chat, text completions and embeddings with Nscale.
long_description: Bring a Nscale service token to use OpenAI-compatible serverless inference without storing the token on your Sprite. Saving, replacing and testing a token only list models; the check runs no inference and does not verify inference permissions or credit balance. Inference consumes your Nscale credits. Supports model discovery, chat completions, text completions and embeddings, including SSE streaming for completions. Images, endpoint management, compute, storage, service tokens, billing and account management are not forwarded.

examples.title: Chat completion (uses your Nscale credits)

messages.content: Explain serverless inference in two sentences.

notes: Set stream to true for SSE. Use GET /v1/models to check current model IDs and availability.

examples.title: Text completion; replace MODEL_ID (uses your Nscale credits)
notes: Replace MODEL_ID with a model that supports text completions; model capabilities vary.

json.input: Sprites run applications in isolated environments.

messages.401: Nscale service token is invalid or expired; replace it in this connection
messages.403: Nscale service token lacks permission for this operation; check its role and scope
messages.404: Nscale model not found or unavailable; check GET /v1/models
messages.429: Nscale rejected the request; check your available credits and the provider error

presentation.tagline: Nscale serverless inference without storing your service token on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Sign in at console.nscale.com, open Settings → Service Tokens and create a service token with access to models and inference. Copy the token when it is shown, then paste it here.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving, replacing and testing a token only call `GET /v1/models` and run no paid inference. Chat, text completions and embeddings consume your Nscale credits. A successful check does not verify inference permissions or credit balance; Nscale documents 429 for insufficient credit.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/completions` and `POST /v1/embeddings` are forwarded. Completions can stream with SSE. Images, endpoint management, compute, storage, service tokens, billing and account management are not forwarded.

notices.title: Token expiry
notices.body: Nscale service tokens are time-limited. Rotate an expiring token in Nscale and replace it in this connection; the connector does not refresh tokens automatically.
